data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 公寓厨房的细致熬汤
data.description: 公寓厨房内飘散着浓郁的日式炖菜香气。系着围裙的雪菜用木勺尝完味道，转过头认真地对你眨着清澈褐瞳，娇嗔叮嘱前辈不能挑食，满脸初为人妻的羞赧甜意。
data.action: tasting soup from wooden spoon, turning to partner with earnest caring smile, blushing softly, steam from pot
data.lighting: warm cozy domestic lamplight shining on kitchen tiles
data.mood: tender homemaker affection, junior-girlfriend sweetness, domestic comfort
data.promptProse: Cooking in a warm apartment kitchen in a cute apron, Yukina Himeragi tastes soup from a wooden spoon, smiling with earnest affection at her senior.
data.animaCaption: Tasting the evening stew in her apron, she turns with an affectionate blushing smile.
